fixes.what: Change `.cta--poster{padding-top:calc(var(--header-h) + clamp(48px,8vh,80px));...}` to `.cta--poster{padding-top:clamp(64px,10vh,112px);padding-bottom:clamp(64px,10vh,112px);min-height:0;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--header-h) + 8px)}` and add `.cta--poster::before{inset:16px}` spacing so the cream wordmark inside `.cta--poster` does not clip under the fixed `.site-header` when scrolling past the leaf band.
fixes.why: In `index-desktop-4.jpg`, the fixed header bar cuts directly across the top half of `.cta__wordmark` ('ANAR EVENTS') inside the brown poster CTA.

fixes.what: Add `scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--header-h) + 24px)` to `.inquire` or increase `.section` top padding when scrolled so the section eyebrow ('Inquire' / 'شروع برنامه‌ریزی') is not clipped by the fixed header bar.
fixes.why: In `index-desktop-3.jpg`, the top eyebrow and Persian text of the Inquire section are sliced in half by the bottom edge of the fixed header.

fixes.what: Add `` inside `.site-header__end` on all inner pages (`weddings.html`, `how-we-work.html`, `about.html`).
fixes.why: Inner pages run continuous GSAP branch sway and scroll parallax (`site.js` block 3), so users on inner pages need the same accessible pause control that `index.html` provides.

fixes.what: Add `srcset` and `sizes="(min-width:900px) 440px, 100vw"` to the `.reveal-img` images (`pom-open-closeup.jpg`, `pom-in-hand.jpg`, `pom-pile.jpg`) matching the responsive variants used in `index.html` and `about.html`.
fixes.why: `weddings.html` serves full-resolution 1500px–2000px JPEGs directly to 390px mobile viewports instead of using the `-800.jpg` and `-1200.jpg` responsive variants.

fixes.what: Add `ScrollTrigger.refresh()` inside a `toggle` event listener on all `<details>` elements (`$$('details').forEach(d => d.addEventListener('toggle', () => hasGsap && ScrollTrigger.refresh()))`).
fixes.why: Opening or closing `<details>` in `.options` or `.faq` changes document height without notifying ScrollTrigger, desynchronizing downstream scroll triggers and parallax bounds.
